what: Reproduce the primary interval from aggregate summaries
title: Scientific example gallery
text: one small reproduction check using released aggregate summaries. Participant-level records bundled. Data provenance field meanings appear data dictionary.
code: summary_path <- system.file("extdata", "clinical_dose_summary.tsv", package = "emaxProjection") summary <- read.delim(summary_path) variance <- sum((summary$n - 1) * summary$sd^2) / (sum(summary$n) - nrow(summary)) region <- emax_region_from_summary(summary$dose, summary$n, summary$mean,   pooled_variance = variance, D = 4, calibration = "contrast") clinical_result <- emax_project(region) clinical_result #> Integrated Emax response | contrast calibration #> Status: nonempty; termination: endpoint_tolerance #> Outer interval: [0.00950952, 0.624582] #> Endpoint gaps: 0.000507594, 0.000933858; converged: TRUE #> Ordinary double precision; no directed-rounding certificate. primary <- intervals[intervals$method == "contrast_projection_v1", ] stopifnot(max(abs(clinical_result$interval - c(primary$lower, primary$upper))) < 1e-8)
